typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  [Group_NPI]       ,[Group_Name]       ,[PCP_NPI]       ,[PCP_FNAME]       ,[PCP_LNAME]       ,[PCP_ADDRESS_LINE_1]       ,[PCP_ADDRESS_LINE_2]       ,[PCP_CITY]       ,[PCP_STATE]       ,[PCP_ZIP_CODE]       ,[PCP_COUNTY]       ,[PCP_PRIMARY_PHONE]       ,[MEMBER_MEDICAID_NBR]       ,[MEMBER_DOB]       ,[MEM_PRIMARY_PHONE_NBR]    FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[NV_TOC_PCP_EXTRACT]     WHERE [EXCD_ID] = ?   ORDER BY [PCP_NPI]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTablePOMELONICUAUTHSEXTRACT
SourceTablePOMELONICUAUTHSEXTRACT sink(input(
		PCP_LNAME as string,
		PCP_ZIP_CODE as string,
		PCP_COUNTY as string,
		PCP_FNAME as string,
		PCP_ADDRESS_LINE_1 as string,
		PCP_CITY as string,
		MEMBER_MEDICAID_NBR as string,
		Group_NPI as string,
		PCP_STATE as string,
		PCP_PRIMARY_PHONE as string,
		PCP_ADDRESS_LINE_2 as string,
		Group_Name as string,
		MEM_PRIMARY_PHONE_NBR as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		PCP_NPI as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PCP_LNAME,
		PCP_ZIP_CODE,
		PCP_COUNTY,
		PCP_FNAME,
		PCP_ADDRESS_LINE_1,
		PCP_CITY,
		MEMBER_MEDICAID_NBR,
		Group_NPI,
		PCP_STATE,
		PCP_PRIMARY_PHONE,
		PCP_ADDRESS_LINE_2,
		Group_Name,
		MEM_PRIMARY_PHONE_NBR,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		PCP_NPI)) ~> FlatFilePCP
